assays.assay_description: Open-field activity chamber (ENV-510, Med Associates) partitioned into two equally-sized zones by a clear Plexiglas wall with a hole, each zone containing a distinct novel bedding. 30-min pre-conditioning and post-conditioning trials measured time spent in each zone, with normalized and subtracted social preference scores computed. Tested across psilocybin, LSD, ketamine, ibogaine, MDMA, ±ketanserin, in WT and β-arrestin-2 KO mice, at multiple post-treatment timepoints (48 h to 4 weeks).

application_type.evidence: single intraperitoneal (i.p.) dose of psilocybin ... LSD (i.p. 1 µg/kg) ... ketamine (i.p. 3 mg/kg) ... ibogaine (i.p. 40 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were habituated to the injection procedure but apparatus-specific habituation is not described.

setup_restrain.evidence: The amount of time spent freely exploring each zone was recorded during 30-min test sessions.

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water provided ad libitum in home cage; no food in the testing apparatus during the 30-min sCPP session.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water provided ad libitum in home cage; no water in the testing apparatus during the 30-min sCPP session.

time_to_assay.evidence: tested 48 h after the injection ... One week ... Two weeks ... three weeks ... four weeks after pretreatment

sample_size.evidence: n values across sub-experiments range from 6 (LSD 48h) to 23 (LSD 3 weeks); group sizes reported per figure panel.

outcomes.summary: Acute pretreatment with psilocybin (0.3 mg/kg), LSD (1 µg/kg), ketamine (3 mg/kg), ibogaine (40 mg/kg) and MDMA all reinstated social conditioned place preference in adult mice 48 h after dosing, whereas saline did not. The duration of the open state was drug-specific (ketamine <1 wk, psilocybin ~2 wk, LSD ~3 wk, ibogaine ≥4 wk), proportional to acute subjective duration in humans. LSD- and psilocybin-induced reinstatement was blocked by ketanserin (5-HT2AR antagonist), while MDMA and ketamine effects were ketanserin-insensitive; LSD and MDMA effects required β-arrestin-2, ketamine and ibogaine did not.
outcomes.evidence: Mice pretreated with psilocybin, but not saline, exhibited a significant sCPP at P98 ... pretreatment with LSD ... also reopened the critical period for social reward learning.

B1_num_measures.evidence: normalized social preference scores (time spent in social zone post-treatment divided by pre-treatment) and subtracted social preference scores (time spent in social zone post minus pre)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Results reported as total time over 30-min sessions; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis described.

B4_ethological.evidence: Measure is zone preference time (a spatial measure), not ethological acts; 'Mice are never excluded based on the quality of their social interactions.'

B5_social.evidence: Social conditioning with cage mates for 24 h, but test trial is conducted with the focal mouse alone choosing between bedding cues.

B6_cognitive.evidence: CPP is a learned association between a condition (for example, social) and a cue (bedding).

B7_automated_classification.evidence: open field activity chamber (ENV-510, Med Associates) equipped with infrared beams and a software interface (Activity Monitor, Med Associates) — position tracking only.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Analyses use t-tests on individual preference measures; no PCA/clustering.

assays.assay_description: CPP paradigm with 5 mg/kg cocaine conditioning, following i.p. pretreatment with saline or LSD. Time spent in the cocaine-paired context measured, with normalized and subtracted cocaine preference scores reported.

setup_habituation.evidence: Not described for cocaine CPP specifically.

setup_restrain.evidence: Freely-moving CPP paradigm with no restraint mentioned.

food_restriction.evidence: Ad libitum food in housing; no food in CPP apparatus during testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Ad libitum water in housing; no water in CPP apparatus during testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: Exact timing between LSD pretreatment and cocaine CPP test not specified.

sample_size.evidence: saline (n=8) and LSD (n=8) both develop significantly increased preference for the cocaine context

outcomes.summary: Both saline- and LSD-pretreated mice developed significant cocaine CPP, with no difference between groups, indicating LSD pretreatment does not alter cocaine reward learning.
outcomes.evidence: Comparisons reveal no difference in normalized cocaine preference ... and subtracted cocaine preference.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Normalized cocaine preference and subtracted cocaine preference both reported.

B5_social.evidence: No social component in cocaine CPP.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding mentioned for cocaine CPP.

D1_continuity.evidence: CPP includes pre- and post-conditioning trials.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Session duration not explicitly stated for cocaine CPP.

D4_baseline.evidence: Pre-conditioning baseline trial implicit in CPP design.

assays.assay_description: Locomotor activity recorded across multiple days of repeated 20 mg/kg amphetamine administration following 3 days of saline pretreatment; MDMA administered after day 12 and locomotor response retested on day 16.

application_type.evidence: i.p. injections; MDMA administered i.p. after day 12.

food_restriction.evidence: Ad libitum in home cage; no food in locomotor chamber.

water_restriction.evidence: Ad libitum in home cage; no water in locomotor chamber.

time_to_assay.evidence: Locomotor activity assessed across sensitization days, including day 12 and day 16 after MDMA administration.

outcomes.summary: MDMA administration did not significantly alter amphetamine-induced locomotor sensitization (comparing day 12 vs day 16).
outcomes.evidence: Administration of MDMA after day 12 did not significantly alter the locomotor response to amphetamine (day 12 versus day 16, n=12, t(11)=2.2171, P=0.443).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Locomotor activity (distance traveled) as single outcome.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total session locomotion reported, not within-session dynamics.

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological act per rubric.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Locomotor sensitization measured here as a physiological/pharmacological response, not a cognitive task per rubric.

D1_continuity.evidence: Locomotor activity recorded across multiple sensitization days (e.g., day 12 and day 16).

D3_recording_days.evidence: Locomotor activity during sensitization to amphetamine following 3 days of saline pretreatment, with recordings through day 12 and day 16.

D4_baseline.evidence: 3 days of saline pretreatment recording precedes amphetamine administration.

D5_followup.evidence: No follow-up >24 h after final drug dose described.

judge_notes: Consolidated all sCPP variants (different psychedelics, doses, timepoints, ketanserin co-administration, β-arrestin-2 KO, juvenile/adult, multi-week durations) into a single sCPP assay entry per rubric: same paradigm, apparatus, and measurements differ only by drug/genotype/timepoint manipulations.
Retained Cocaine CPP and Amphetamine Locomotor Sensitization as separate assays (different paradigms/constructs from sCPP); both involve psychedelic (LSD or MDMA) administration to rodents.
B1 for sCPP scored 1 (2-3 measures: raw time, normalized preference, subtracted preference) — chose modal value across candidates; glm's score of 2 inconsistent with rubric (2-3 measures = 1 point).

D3 for sCPP scored 1 (2-7 days): pre-conditioning trial + post-conditioning trial = 2 recording days per animal (each mouse used at one timepoint), consistent with explicit statement 'Each mouse was used for only one behavioural time point.' Overrode gptoss's D4=0 since pre-conditioning trial is explicitly recorded as baseline preference.
D5 (post-acute follow-up) for sCPP scored 1: behavioural testing occurs 48 h to 4 weeks after drug dosing, well >24 h.
Handling scored 'yes' based on explicit habituation to injection procedure with daily saline i.p. injections in the home cage.
enrichment_housing scored 'not_reported' (corncob bedding mentioned but no enrichment items described); confidence low.
Dropped ex vivo electrophysiology (mEPSC recordings in NAc/mPFC slices) and RNA-seq as non-behavioural per rubric.
D2 for cocaine CPP and amphetamine sensitization left as low confidence as paper does not state session durations explicitly for these assays.
